overviewHtml:
This graded quiz assesses your understanding of the blind spot argument and what follows from it. You'll be asked about the argument itself, its roots in Husserl and Merleau-Ponty and its critics, and the parts of a phenomenologically informed position.

Note: Aim for a score of 80 percent or higher. If you score lower, use the feedback to review the topics you missed, then retake the quiz.
